ExA-SPIM 2024 · author estimate

Expansion microscopy

2024 · year as printed in Table A1

≈100 billion voxels/$

≈$1×10⁻¹¹ per voxel

Illustrative human-brain acquisition cost: $18.75B per human brain

Illustrative conversion: 1.875×10²¹ voxels (~1.9 sextillion), at 4×4×40 nm across 1,200,000 mm³, ÷ source-estimated voxels per dollar. Image acquisition only; excludes preparation, reconstruction, proofreading and storage. Optical and EM scopes and resolutions differ; this is not a matched whole-brain project budget.

Compiling molecular ultrastructure into neural dynamics — arXiv:2603.25713v1, Table A1 (p. 18) ↗

Table A1 row 2: ExA-SPIM; Approx. Voxels/$ = 100,000,000,000. Rough order-of-magnitude author estimate. Citation mismatch: reference 54 is Day et al. (2024), HiExM, rather than ExA-SPIM. Independent ExA-SPIM throughput and this cost configuration are unverified. Included as the authors’ estimate, with the mismatch disclosed.
